map.💡 公式：所需总光通量 = 推荐照度(lux) × 面积(m²) ÷ 利用系数(: 💡 Formula: required total flux = recommended illuminance (lux) × area (m²) ÷ utilization factor (0.6) ÷ maintenance factor (0.8); luminaire count = total flux ÷ single flux (round up). 1 lux = 1 lm/m².

map.所需总光通量=推荐照度(lux)×面积÷(利用系数 UF×维护系数 MF)，UF: Required total flux = recommended illuminance (lux) × area ÷ (UF × MF), with UF, MF = 0.6, 0.8; luminaire count = ceil(total flux ÷ single flux). Recommended CCT/illuminance vary by scene (living 3000K/150lux, office 4000K/300lux, reading 4000K/500lux).
map.客厅（3000K/150lux）、面积 20 m²、单灯 800 lm：总光通=: Living room (3000K/150lux), 20 m², 800 lm/luminaire: total flux = 150×20÷(0.6×0.8)=6250 lm, count = ceil(6250÷800)=8; same area study (change to 4000K/500lux): total flux = 500×20÷0.48=20833 lm, about 27 luminaires (or use higher-flux ones).
map.利用系数和维护系数什么用？: What are the utilization and maintenance factors for?
map.UF 反映灯具光通落到工作面的比例（受反射与配光影响），MF 反映灯具老化积尘衰: UF reflects the fraction of luminaire flux reaching the work plane (affected by reflection and photometry); MF reflects aging and dust attenuation. Ignoring them badly underestimates the needed count and causes insufficient illuminance.
map.低色温（2700~3000K）暖黄、放松氛围；中高色温（4000K）中性白、清爽: Low CCT (2700–3000K) warm/yellow, relaxing; mid-high (4000K) neutral white, fresh and focused; reading/kitchen should be ≥4000K with enough illuminance for eye comfort.
map.照明色温亮度配置工具根据应用场景推荐合适的色温与照度，并结合房间面积与单灯光通量: This lighting color-temperature & brightness tool recommends suitable CCT and illuminance by application, and computes required total flux and luminaire count from room area and single-luminaire flux, aiding indoor lighting design and luminaire selection.
